reading.body:
Seven video sources are tracked here, split between recorded course lectures, Stanford's CS229 and MIT's 6.S191, and product or industry events, Google I/O and NVIDIA's GTC keynote, with 3Blue1Brown's visual series and Karpathy's LLM explainer sitting between the two as independently produced educational content.

The NVIDIA GTC keynote is worth noting specifically because it is where the AI hardware roadmap gets announced each year, which connects this list directly to the compute and infrastructure layer that the rest of this site treats as the binding constraint on AI scaling, rather than being purely an educational resource in the way the lecture series are.

The data does not say how long each video or series runs, how often the conference talks and keynotes are updated year to year beyond what is archived, or which of the seven has the widest viewership.
